column1: # Vendored external agent skills — single source of truth for coding-agents/vendor/fetch.sh
# Skills listed here are fetched from upstream repos at a PINNED commit and
# written into ../skills/<name>/ (gitignored payload). Only this manifest,
# fetch.sh and README.md are tracked. To update: bump PIN, re-run ./fetch.sh.
# The file is read top-to-bottom: REPO/PIN/LICENSE set the current source for
# the skill lines that follow, so multiple REPO/PIN blocks can coexist.
LICENSE=MIT (mizchi/skills repo default; no per-skill LICENSE.txt upstream)
# Second source: official ast-grep agent skill (authoritative rule reference)
LICENSE=none (no LICENSE file upstream; payload is gitignored, not redistributed)
